description: Defines a finite state machine class for managing the state of a ZeroMQ-based radio receive channel, including state transitions, timers, and status checks.

classes.name: radio_zmq_rx_channel_fsm
classes.description: Finite state machine managing the states of a ZeroMQ radio receive channel, including initialization, data reception, error handling, and stopping.

methods.name: init_successful
methods.description: Sets the state to indicate the receive stream has been successfully initialized and starts the timer.

methods.name: on_error
methods.description: Sets the state to stopped due to an unrecoverable error.

methods.name: request_sent
methods.description: Transitions the state to receive data upon receiving a request, and restarts the timer.

methods.name: data_received
methods.description: Transitions the state back to send request after data is received, and restarts the timer.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Signals the FSM to stop if it is currently running.

methods.name: async_task_stopped
methods.description: Sets the state to stopped when the asynchronous task has been notified to stop.

methods.name: is_running
methods.description: Checks if the FSM is in an operational state (sending request or receiving data).

methods.name: has_pending_response
methods.description: Checks if the FSM is currently waiting for data (pending response).

methods.name: has_wait_expired
methods.description: Checks if the wait time for request or data has expired based on the timer.
